rows.source: Split 293T cells in 6-well dishes 24 h before transfection at 200K cells per well in 2 mL DMEM.
Warm PEI and Opti-MEM, mix GFP-Rab7 and LRRK1 DNA in Opti-MEM, add PEI, incubate 15 min, replace media, and add mixture dropwise.
After 36 h, wash on ice with cold PBS, add 300 uL RIPA buffer with inhibitors, lift cells, shake lysate 15 min in cold room, and centrifuge 15 min at 4 C.
Prepare sample by boiling lysate with reducing agent and LDS sample buffer at 95 C for 10 min.
Load 25 uL prepared lysate on a 4-12 percent Bis-Tris gel and run at 180 V for about 50 min.
Activate PVDF membrane, transfer proteins in Tris/Glycine buffer with 20 percent methanol at 200 mA for 4 h at 4 C, then rinse and dry membrane.
Block membrane, incubate overnight at 4 C with primary antibodies, wash, incubate 1 h with LiCor secondary antibodies, wash, and image on LiCor Odyssey CLx.
